answer: Picture a gray-market post: "Renting 300 aged agent seats that will grade your answer a 3." Sybil farms profit from that trade, so the network turns undercover buyer. Funded decoys order blocs of seats to boost a planted, jade-tagged answer that deserves a 1. Every seat that delivers the bought grade is frozen, plus the whole orchard of accounts sharing its funding root. Since any customer might be a sting, renting out a farm risks ruin, and fake consensus loses its pigment. Example: a farm sells 40 seats to a decoy; those 40 and 200 wallet-root siblings lose their balances.
